SELECT lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
  count() AS log_rows, uniqExact(uuid) AS log_uuids, uniqExact(span_id) AS log_span_ids,
  countIf(severity_text = 'ERROR') AS error_log_rows,
  countIf(body NOT IN ('mikka.stage.completed', 'mikka.stage.failed')) AS unexpected_body_rows
FROM logs
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-09 02:43:10', 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-09 02:43:12', 'UTC')
  AND service_name = 'mikka-web'
  AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'dev'
  AND resource_attributes['service.version'] = '1d1261b607c8d60a27e2131ef59b463156d346d1'
  AND trace_id IN (base64Encode(unhex('142e5c51ad8f7ccf5b0ee00ee5974fc7')), base64Encode(unhex('18aa62f9b603d3fbe1c5b69ed14ee70d')), base64Encode(unhex('1c0ce5cb77ec34d689a629c48c8d1ce5')), base64Encode(unhex('214ef3d5f15104544ee4c93d8d0a0465')), base64Encode(unhex('2e79557078cd398fffba9b521f1cd130')), base64Encode(unhex('2f7c169fa19a3f77b899506ca7df8f7d')), base64Encode(unhex('42170c9357e9d05a66a874e69fc1615d')), base64Encode(unhex('570a22f1d589534befe0d4dad97c87c6')), base64Encode(unhex('58ed88c9d5faa22053ce3bbd25850747')), base64Encode(unhex('5b8b4c28b5ba2e13335411ba0701c903')), base64Encode(unhex('7030ffd78b98df3e6abcd922eeeedc1f')), base64Encode(unhex('75dc3064bde7124904087f98e5b05cb8')), base64Encode(unhex('7de6056348d9c1cab657ed06b3f8449a')), base64Encode(unhex('8063811ce484c0b392f49fec65e1e427')), base64Encode(unhex('a5b501b3cb2f80fad9a2e96e65ef6eee')), base64Encode(unhex('c94701a417b50a28405e753ddf45cd11')), base64Encode(unhex('cb4cd300706d382dd5479cdc11590568')), base64Encode(unhex('f57d8fe0f040c11885c9cb01261a5ca7')), base64Encode(unhex('f5dac85c72e9138b4cc53797892a596e')), base64Encode(unhex('fb64a993ca432ae0392d4c100d4833fc')))
